hook: Seventeen researchers sailed 830 nautical miles to solve a 1937 disappearance.

sections.voiceover: Seventeen researchers sailed 830 nautical miles to solve a 1937 disappearance.
b_roll: Map showing the South Pacific voyage to Nikumaroro Island

sections.voiceover: Purdue University launched the expedition on October 12 aboard the Marin Mainiku vessel. Rick Pettigrew led the team across the ocean. What anomaly waited at Nikumaroro?
Except a 17-person boat crew also joined the dangerous Pacific search.
Satellite imagery revealed a mysterious target on the remote island shore. Steve Schultz coordinated the university investigation.
Seventeen researchers reached the Nikumaroro anomaly after 5 days.
